title: Opening: microphone check, date and Tulane archive visit
summary: Allen sets up the microphone and states the date, 14 April 1970, at the Archive of New Orleans Jazz. Leclerc says he is happy to have heard his old music.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: All right, it's rolling? Yeah, it's rolling. You want to set that microphone?
How is it? Is it close enough to... Just say your name so we can pick it up and get the microphone situated right.
Irwin Leclerc, can you get that out there?
Oh, yeah. Is that your full name?

Mm-hmm, and what's today's date? It's... Today, the 14th. April the 14th, 1970. Yeah, April the 14th, 1970. And we're sitting here in the Archive of New Orleans Jazz at Tulane Library. You came up. I wanted to show you some of your music, and it's been a surprise for you, huh?
Oh, I was happy to hear it, I tell you.
Stuff that I hadn't even thought of remembering.
